name: retroloop-version
description: Tells an open session when a plugin in the local marketplace has a newer version installed than the one this session loaded, so the human knows to type /reload-plugins.
command: while :; do d=$CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT; [ -n "$d" ] || d=$(ls -td "$HOME"/.claude/plugins/cache/retroloop/retroloop/*/ 2>/dev/null | head -n1); [ -n "$d" ] && bash "$d/scripts/version-drift.sh" --watch 60; sleep 60; done
